setup.effects: Local shared Base installer: preserve private settings, migrate local D1, claim the first owner once, capture sign-in in the dev outbox and stop the application.

deploy.effects: Deploy an existing committed build through the full Base owner-account kit: find/create owned resources, apply remote D1 migrations, upload Worker, read back bindings and verify source/version health. Requires explicit owner credentials and persistent ownership state.

verify.effects: Checks source integrity, operations tooling, TypeScript, production build, local D1 and browser tests. No hosted acceptance claim.

export.effects: Complete local D1/R2 export with private-authority binding and explicit exclusions.

import.effects: Confirmed atomic import into an empty local destination; no remote effects.

preview.effects: Serve fixed production output, preserve local owner and durable state, stop after idle timeout or explicit stop.

reset.effects: Confirmed deletion of inventoried local state/private settings only; no remote effects.

release.effects: Verified private release artifacts; never pushes or deploys.

authentication.deployment: Protected stage/live-proof runner credentials only. Inspection never logs in or reads credential files. Production requires owner dispatch.
authentication.operators: Base operator-auth: one explicit first-owner claim, confirmed magic links, equal product operators, persistent version fences and last-operator protection. Hosted authentication needs separate exact-revision evidence.

health.semantics: Worker response and version only; does not establish provider capability, domain verification, delivery or release acceptance.
